title: hieracium ericetorum
intro: Hieracium ericetorum, commonly known as Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a perennial herb belonging to the daisy family. Mouse-ear Hawkweed has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its antioxidant, antitumor, and immunomodulatory effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential and to isolate the specific mechanisms by which these bioactive compounds exert their effects.
